name: Unidoc Health Corp.
summary: Based in Vancouver, Canada, UniDoc Health Corp., established in 2021 and formerly known as Unicheck Holdings Corp. until April 2021, is a Canadian provider of virtual healthcare and telemedicine solutions. The company's core offering, "Virtual Health Clinics," is a customizable platform engineered to securely connect patients in various settings, from metropolitan areas to isolated regions, with vital medical care. These clinics also empower rapid, real-time diagnostic testing, enable therapeutic interventions, and support continuous health monitoring.
